text:
jordan: heads up — noticed multiple pages from incidentbot in the last 10m that show as delivered to pager provider but never got acked in our incident channel. customers reported missed pages.

maria: confirmed, I'm seeing 200s from notify-bridge -> pager provider but no activity in #incidents thread. looks like ack events aren't being translated back.

opsbot: IncidentBot triggered: ALERT: notify-bridge-high-error-rate (severity: P2) — routing to oncall team.

sam: @maria i'm oncall, i didn't get an SMS or push for the first two alerts. got a later manual escalation at +7m.

jordan: digging into logs now. tracing notify-bridge -> pagerflow. provider returned request-id: rf-9a3b but our callback shows 202 with no mapping id.

maria: possible identity translation mismatch between notify-bridge user ids and pager provider external ids. maybe a recent deploy to notify-bridge changed header format.

jordan: grabbing redis mapping: `redis-cli HGET pager:user:external 12345` shows NULL for some users. older entries still present.

natalie: customer impact: Support ticket #7891 — customer reports they didn't get paged for an outage window ~00:14-00:22 UTC. this overlaps the orphaned acks.

sam: workaround: please do manual page to my phone +1-555-0199 while we triage. use the SMS fallback route.

maria: manual SMS succeeded. sam acknowledged at 4123456921. the incident channel still didn't record an ack (no incidentbot update).

jordan: minimal repro: POST to /v1/notify/send with header `X-Notifier-User: user-123` then check callback to /webhooks/pagerflow/ack. callback contains `provider_id: rf-9a3b` but our webhook handler expects `external_user` field. so it drops the ack.

maria: rolling back the notify-bridge headers patch to previous format now. deploying rollback-2026-03-17/notify-bridge. ETA ~90s.

opsbot: Deploy started: rollback-2026-03-17/notify-bridge by maria — track: https://deploys.redwood/rollback-2026-03-17

jordan: while rollback is in progress, enabling routing fallback: set `FORCE_SMS_FALLBACK=true` on alert-router so pages go directly to SMS provider if no ack seen after 30s.

maria: rollback complete, new logs show callback payload now contains `external_user` again. reprocessing ack queue.

jordan: reprocessor job `ack-sync` picked up ~12 orphaned acks and reconciled them — posting synthetic ack events to incidentbot.

opsbot: IncidentBot update: 12 acks reconciled, incident status: acknowledged by sam.

natalie: flagged affected customers and created follow-up ticket: CS-1256 for outreach + incident summary.

sam: thanks team. can we add a check in e2e to validate callback shape and a synthetic ack flow? i missed early alerts.

maria: agree — follow-ups: 1) e2e ack roundtrip test in CI (owner: eng-infra) 2) add payload schema validation at webhook handler (owner: eng-runtime) 3) add metrics/alert for unmatched provider callbacks (owner: eng-sre).

jordan: i've added a short playbook entry in runbook/tasks: `if ack-less pages > 3 in 5m -> enable SMS fallback and escalate to infra`

natalie: customer comms draft uploaded to CS, will coordinate with ops for timing.

sam: closing the active mitigation. please add postmortem notes and severity assessment. P2 for now due to partial customer impact.

maria: creating postmortem issue: PM-2026-03-notify-bridge-ack-orphaning. will include timeline + SHA of offending deploy.

jordan: final note — observed root cause: header/field rename in notify-bridge deploy (missing `external_user`) which caused webhook handler to drop ack events silently. adding schema validation should prevent silent drops.

opsbot: Incident resolved: notify-bridge-ack-orphaning — mitigations applied, reprocessor completed, follow-ups created. :white_check_mark:
